care.name: Client Support Team
care.line: Ricky Rampersad Branch · Guardian Life of the Caribbean

next.callme: Someone from the branch calls you today or tomorrow, at a time you choose.
next.urgent: We read every word you wrote before we name anyone, then match you to the agent who fits your file.
next.review: A person reads your review, then we match you to the agent who fits your file.
next.paid: We check the record against your receipt and confirm within two working days.
next.pay: We call to set up payment to Guardian Life directly, with Guardian Life's own receipt every time.
next.claim: We bring the maturity form and walk it through with you.
next.deliver: We bring your contract and go through it with you. The only signature it needs is the acknowledgement.
next.finish: We bring whatever is still needed to finish your application. You do not have to find anything.
next.stop: We close the file properly and confirm that nothing is owed.
next.question: A person answers your question the same day.
next.assign: We match you to the agent who fits your file, and introduce you.
next.selfserve: Take your time with the review. It saves as you go, and a person reads it the day you send it.

next_q.rate_better: Someone from the branch calls you today or tomorrow to hear what we should do better.
next_q.life_changed: Someone from the branch calls you today or tomorrow to check your cover still fits your life.
next_q.whopays_unsure: We check who your policy pays and go through it with you by phone, once we have confirmed it is you.
next_q.approached_yes: A person reads what was suggested and calls you before you decide anything.

still.subject: Still on it, {{first_name}}.
still.line: You have not been forgotten, and {{care_us}} is still on it. {{next}} We will ask again rather than assume, and you are welcome to reply here at any time.
